name: peco-configurable-unicode-normalization-0641
instr:
peco cannot match canonically equivalent queries and lines while preserving visible text, selection, and output. Add none, NFC, and NFD normalization through a `--normalize` command-line flag and configuration. An explicit command-line value overrides configuration; otherwise use `Config.Normalization`, with complete omission preserving current behavior. Reject invalid values before filtering.

Use one resolved mode for every filter from `peco.NewFilter`: IgnoreCase, CaseSensitive, SmartCase, Regexp, IRegexp, fuzzy, and external. A Normalizer must return normalized text and map every normalized boundary to its original byte boundary. Report original display ranges without changing line identity, buffer, display, output, dirty state, null-separated partitions, regexp semantics, fuzzy ranking, positive and negative terms, or ordering.

Parallel filters must match serial ordered results and ranges. Sorted fuzzy results must keep deterministic normalized ranking. Refined queries and mode changes must match complete-source evaluation under the final query and mode.

ExternalCmd must send each complete buffered stream of normalized queries and display text to one process, preserve its output order, reconcile returned text with original lines, and create lines for unseen output. Preserve original identity and output, including null-separated lines and differently encoded lines that normalize equally. Report startup and read errors without inventing matches.

Keep canonically equival
